title: Olink® Target 96 Part 3/3: Detection
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input your protocol parameters in the Opentrons interface as prompted.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package and unzip it if needed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and upload the required labware files with .json extensions.

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: Upload the protocol Python file (with a .py extension) to the OT App in the Protocol tab.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map, placing all labware in the indicated slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate the labware, tip rack, and pipette using the OT App’s calibration routine.

steps.title: Transfer primers and samples
steps.instruction: Transfer primers to the left 96 wells of the Fluidigm detection plate and samples to the right 96 wells, following the supplied transfer mapping images.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press ‘Run’ in the OT App to start the detection protocol.
